title: IncidentConditions
description: The incident doc's `conditions` field: the typed temperature and wet answer that drive the urgency chip (shared/constants/urgency.json). Written by command; read by every member.

tempF.description: Typed air temperature in Fahrenheit, or null when not known

wet.description: Typed: is the person likely wet (rain, sweat, water)? null when unanswered (counts as dry)

setAtMs.description: Client time the values were typed
